en: Ahhh... I'm so tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>A lot's happened today...but there's
still something bothering me.

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>
this afternoon...
<CLT=cltMIND>All those meteorites...
<CLT=cltMIND>The Gofer Project...
<CLT=cltMIND>The mysterious cult organization...

<CLT=cltMIND>Are they connected to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>,
or the <CLT=cltSTRONG>funeral<CLT=cltMIND>, or the killing game?
<CLT=cltMIND>Those answers...might save us.

<CLT=cltMIND>But no matter how hard I try to solve it,
it's all a mystery.

<CLT=cltMIND>Thinking about everything I saw,
I had fallen asleep before I knew it.

Have you ever wondered why soccer players
have numbers on their jerseys?

It's how many mochi each player gets in the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>red bean soup<CLT=cltNORMAL> they eat after the game.

It's too much work for the guy who's making the
soup to check each player after the game.

It's much easier to check during the game
when the number is on their uniforms.

That way, they can just prepare the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>red bean soup<CLT=cltNORMAL> during the game...

And then the <CLT=cltSTRONG>red bean soup<CLT=cltNORMAL> will be ready to
eat as soon as the game is over.

And if players want a different number of mochi,
they can just trade jerseys with each other.

You know how after the game, players will
sometimes trade jerseys?

That's how they exchange the number of
mochi they have to eat after the game.

Oh, but for baseball jerseys, the number is how
many pieces of meat they get in their curry.

And for volleyball, it's how many pieces of
sliced pork they get in their ramen...

As you can see, jersey numbers vary greatly
depending on the sport.

This has been the Random Trivia Corner,
brought to you by Monokuma!
Boo-hoo-hoo...

It's 8 a.m.! How long are you gonna keep
crying, you annoying bitch!?

You know how busy I am with band practice,
arcade games, and pachinko!?
Now gimme some money! Hurry up!

N-No, please don't kick me in the tummy!
You can...hit my face all you want, though!

Just leave the money on the dresser
and get outta here!

Boo-hoo-hoo... You weren't like this before.
You used to be...so nice...

I've forgotten all about the past!
Did you forget that I'm forgetful!?
C'mon, c'mon! Hurry up!
N-Nooo! Not the tummy!
<CLT=cltMIND>What happened to them overnight?

I suppose it doesn't really matter.
I should head to the dining hall.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
